$comment: Weight and speed budgets (the owner, v2: 'helping speed and being light weight'). Enforced by scripts/budgets.mjs on every ship (bytes) and test/e2e/budgets.spec.ts (@perf, time and requests). Lower a number when you beat it; raising one needs a reason in board/decisions.md.

time.$comment: ms, heavy mock dashboard, every feature on, 4x CPU, warm cache. startPerFeature/startTotal = a feature's own start() work (excluding its chunk load); chunkLoadWall = slowest lazy chunk import (they load concurrently)

requests.$comment: Canvas API requests b2c adds per warm dashboard load beyond Canvas's own (measured against b2c paused); 0 = everything served from cache within TTL
